The session hall is generic: no real seal, no real senator; Senador Gorio, Dalisdis Diking Corporation, the budget line, the notary and every paper are invented (no readable text, blurred logos). Kappa (Japanese folklore) and sarimanok (Maranao art) as helpers. Prompts setting-first; no 'brick', no 'mud'. Copied: full intro (Episode 11). Shots follow sentences.json; k80-k91 are montage extras.
